name: 1-play.jpg
shows: One focal point, from unmodified seeded normal play (wave 10). The robed Warden stands at the brass orrery Core, and the Prism splits the beam into Ember, Azure and Verdant branches that bounce off brass mirrors and walls. Each branch burns a creature of its own colour, and one glances off a creature of another colour, tagged '× WRONG COLOUR'. THE ECLIPSE screams beside them under its Azure crown, with about 7 creatures on screen. The calm HUD shows one top bar (Core 11/12 with '0 = RUN LOST', WAVE 10/10, score 25,635 with x8), the WIN/LOSE line, the boss bar and an INCOMING portrait strip. Chosen by tools/find-cover.mjs (teach mode) from 1,500 runs.

name: 2-title.jpg
shows: The title: the big PRISM WARDEN logo, 'Bend light. Hold the core.', the OBJECTIVE (WIN/LOSE), the Warden at the orrery with creatures around him, the roster of Shades as portraits with names (B opens the Bestiary), MATCH COLOUR as pictures (each beam colour beside the creature it burns), the GENTLE / STANDARD / ECLIPSE+ chips with best per mode, CLICK TO BEGIN, FEATS 3/8 and key caps.

name: 3-boss.jpg
shows: THE ECLIPSE's entrance at the start of wave 10, in normal play: the fight pauses, the view darkens and its calm moon face rises under an Ember corona crown to fill the screen, named 'THE ECLIPSE' on a plate reading 'PHASE I · UMBRA'.

name: 4-results.jpg
shows: VICTORY over the cracked moon face: score 40,035 as NEW BEST (was 28,410), four stats, a score-per-wave chart, the feats earned (4/8), the build as icons with its synergy names (KALEIDOSCOPE + STARFALL + BURNING GLASS) and 'Press R or click to play again'.
